caption: The video captures a horizontal clear glass tube held at its midpoint by a metal clamp on a vertical stand, with blue plastic clips near the clamp and orange end caps containing white cotton plugs at both openings. A faint white vapor occupies the right half of the tube, creeping slightly leftward within that half while remaining separated from the left cotton plug. At the right opening, a slender transparent rod, angled into the tube near the cotton plug, is gradually pulled outward to the right. As it moves, the rod rotates toward a more horizontal orientation and its tip moves out of the tube, then the rod disappears from view. The white cloud stays in the right half and becomes slightly more diffuse, but it never reaches the left end of the tube. The stand, clamp, clips, plugs, caps, table caps, and blackboard remain fixed in view.
